name: tport_route_connect

name: tport_route_connect_if_empty
arguments: uint16 source_pos, uint16 destination_pos, uint16 approach_pos

name: tport_find_id
return: D0.l = one-based transporter ID; level_tport_count + 1 when absent

name: player_tport
return: D0.l = 0 when the teleport is aborted for too few clear landing cells, else -2 (0xFFFFFFFE) after the move; consumed by player_tile_interact at 0x513CE

name: tport_route_write_pair
arguments: uint16 forward_id, uint16 reverse_id, uint32 forward_reverse_words
exceptional_convention: frameless leaf; the two halves of the third argument supply the forward and reverse words

name: tport_route_read_pair
return: D0.l = forward word in bits 31-16 and reverse word in bits 15-0; absent halves are zero

name: maze_forcefield_setup
exceptional_convention: four calls to consume_forcefield_code are indirect through A2

name: consume_forcefield_code
return: D0.l = forcefield code 1-3, or 0 for a non-marker

name: check_forcefield_collision
return: D0.l = 1 on a forcefield tile or 0 otherwise

name: mob_place_tport_anim
exceptional_convention: frameless shared-body entry; saves D3-D7/A5-A6, adds 0x0D to the channel, then branches to insert_mob_depth_sorted

name: tport_create_splodey
exceptional_convention: frameless shared-body entry; saves D3-D7/A5-A6, adds 0x19 to the channel, then branches to insert_mob_depth_sorted

name: pf_isff_d0
return: D0.l = 1 when the coordinate belongs to a forcefield segment or 0 otherwise
exceptional_convention: register-argument entry sharing the pf_isff body

name: pf_isff
return: D0.l = 1 when the coordinate belongs to a forcefield segment or 0 otherwise
exceptional_convention: frameless stack-argument entry eight bytes after pf_isff_d0; establishes its own saved-register frame and shares the body at 0x5FC66
